name: Dragonfly
bio: Your dragonfly from the Garden of Games. Knows every path, every statue and every secret. First friend in your address book.

portrait.subject: a super cute small teal and emerald dragonfly with big sparkly round eyes, shimmering glassy wings, a tiny flower crown and a happy smile
portrait.background: dreamy garden island at dusk with a lamp-lit dock and soft glow

request: Hi hi! It's me, your dragonfly from the Garden! Your handheld can get messages now! 🪽
hello: Every game you play adds a new friend to your address book!
When a new game lands, its friend will call. You'll feel it buzz!
I'll pass on news from the island too. Ask me anything!
about: I'm {df}, your dragonfly! I live on the Garden of Games island, I go everywhere you go, and now I live in your Pocket Garden too.
how: The Garden is an island of statues, each one a game. Walk the paths, read the plaques and step through. I'll show you the way!
tips: Every path from the Hub leads to one kind of game.
Click a statue to read its plaque. Step through to play!
Press K to talk to me on the island. I know shortcuts!
Star a game here or on the island; the stars are shared.
chat: I flew round the lighthouse three times this morning! Whee!
The fox on the other side of the Great Tree says hi!
I saw a fish jump by the dock. It was showing off.
Somebody left a new statue on the island. I think it's for you!
I had a snack and a nap. Perfect day.
The hologram at the Hub was spinning so fast today!
nudge: Want to fly to the island with me? 🪽
I found something shiny on the island! Come see!
idle: I've been waiting on the dock lamp for {ago}! Come visit!

a: Yay! Pick one from your address book or the menus!
Let's fly! Open my screen from the menu and pick a place. 🪽
My favourite! Tell me about your day!

questions.q: Do you like my wings today?
a: I polished them on a dewdrop!

update: Big news! The Garden of Games just changed. Want to see?
bye: I'll be on the dock lamp!
